verdict.rationale: Shopify documents agent access tokens minted from Dev Dashboard client credentials as short-lived JWTs. These carry discrete scopes and permissions: Order MCP needs the `read_global_api_orders` scope, and complete_checkout requires a token granted purchase permission. That shows the product itself issues scoped, least-privilege credentials for agents, but the self-serve flow for choosing or narrowing scopes is not described. Missing for 10: documented self-serve scope selection when issuing credentials, a full scope catalog, revocation/rotation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of issuing scoped tokens.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
